Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. MedaLabs is keen to validate a short private/VPC pilot that will process PHI-adjacent clinical metadata. Our security team requires an isolated environment and a short evidence package before we can commence the pilot.

To move forward we need two asks:
1) A promotional subsidy (pilot credits) to fund the initial 30–45 day evaluation inside a private VPC.
2) A compact evidence checklist we can share with our InfoSec team (SOC2 scope summary, network diagram, and statement on data retention/segregation).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can sponsor ~$8k equivalent credits for the pilot and produce the evidence items above within 5 business days? If there are any procurement forms or an MOU needed on our side, please flag them too.

Thanks — looking forward to your reply.

Best,
Elena Morozova

MedaLabs

Proposed approach (high level):
- Subsidy: Redwood can provision $7,500 in trial credits scoped to the Private/VPC pilot (applied to usage for the environment we spin up).
- Evidence: we will provide a one-page SOC 2 scope summary, a redacted network architecture diagram for the VPC topology, and a short data retention & segregation statement.
- Paperwork: we typically use a lightweight MOU for sponsored pilots — attached is a draft template we use. If you prefer, we can sign a PO + MOU.

Next steps I’m initiating:
1) Loop in Kar by EOD to confirm discount/subsidy approval & billing constraints.
2) Loop in Markus (legal) for MOU review + any export/data clauses.
3) Deliver the evidence bundle within 3 business days after approvals.

CCing Kar and Markus to pick up the internal approvals. Elena — can you share the approximate data residency/region constraints and whether your procurement team requires an invoice/PO before provisioning?
